items.label: MA-AG civil: Gilbane/Hunt
items.detail: Assurance of discontinuance in Suffolk Superior Court alleging false statements on women and minority-owned business participation on the Polar Park project, a joint venture of Gilbane Building Company and Hunt Construction Group; date is the announcement date. The $1.9 million is paid to the state, of which $500,000 is returned to Worcester as restitution; release says nothing on admission.
